cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll time your rehearsal. First, can we agree I helped with the opening paragraph?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The opening, not the whole speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. That's where we chose the argument. I'll leave your name on the programme; could you mention mine when you introduce it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not calling you my co-writer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Call it 'an argument I developed with you.' You've already said where it started.
